blocks.text: JUNK REMOVAL FAQ
Commercial Junk Removal in Oshawa — Asked on the Floor, Answered Straight

items.q: What does commercial junk removal cost in Oshawa?
a: Truck volume is the whole formula: small pickups from $125, larger loads scaling with the space they occupy and nothing else. The figure is written free at your Oshawa property before work starts — heavy lifting, dismantling and all disposal fees inside — and it holds to the invoice.

items.q: How heavy can you actually go?
a: Heavier than most expect from a junk truck. Steel benches, racking runs, compressors, machine components and skid-loads of scrap are standard Oshawa work, moved with proper technique and dismantled where needed. If a piece genuinely requires rigging beyond junk removal scope, we’ll say so up front — not mid-job.

items.q: Can you clear an auto shop without shutting the bays?
a: That’s the booking default. We schedule around your appointment sheet — early, late or Sunday — stage the haul away from active hoists, and keep the work path clear so techs never wait on us. The shop earns straight through its own cleanout.

items.q: Do you handle student-rental turnovers near the colleges?
a: Every May and September, in volume. Multi-unit turnover sweeps near Ontario Tech and Durham College get booked as a wave — documented per unit for landlords, priced at the same volume rates, and cleared fast enough to hit the next lease date.

items.q: How fast can a truck reach my Oshawa business?
a: Often the same day. Oshawa anchors our daily Durham routes, 6AM–11PM, seven days a week, so morning calls to +1 647 922 5865 regularly become afternoon junk pickups — quoted as a real arrival window, not a someday.

items.q: Where does the load go after pickup?
a: Through a proper sort: donation partners take what still works, licensed recyclers take the scrap metal, appliances and e-waste — a big share of any Oshawa load — and landfill receives only what’s left after both. Documentation available on request.

items.q: Can Oshawa shops and landlords book recurring junk removal?
a: Readily. Garages, industrial floors and rental portfolios across the city run on standing schedules — monthly, seasonal or per-turnover — at unchanged volume rates, one consolidated invoice, one contact who knows the site.

items.q: Why are your rates 30–50% below the national junk removal chains?
a: No franchise royalty in the quote — that’s the mechanism. The big brands remit a cut of every Oshawa job to head office; we’re local and independent, so the same load with the same insurance simply costs less, every time.
